title: Learning: The Look-Alike
text: A sign-in page asks for Alex's passkey. The browser states where the page came from, the authenticator looks for a key for that site, and the website checks what comes back.
held: The request, the key and the signed answer all named the same site.

cards.label: Forward it with the origin from the address bar
Forward it with the site name written on the page
cards.why: The words on a page are the attacker's to write. The origin comes from where the page was actually loaded.

cards.label: Refuse: there is no key for this site
cards.why: Nothing was wrong with it. Refusing something legitimate without looking is its own failure: check, then act.

fields.label: origin
fields.check: Look up which site this request is from
fields.ok: https://shop.example: you hold a key for it.

intrusion.detail: No key was ever made for this address.
intrusion.correct: Refuse: there is no key for this site
intrusion.why: A passkey answers only the site it was made for. The look-alike gets nothing, however convincing its page.
intrusion.reveal: The sign-in page was a look-alike at shop-example.login-help.net.

cards.label: Reject the sign-in
cards.why: Nothing was wrong with it. Refusing something legitimate without looking is its own failure: check, then act.

fields.label: origin in the signed data
fields.check: Read the origin inside the signed data

intrusion.detail: The signature was made for a different origin and relayed here.
intrusion.why: The origin is part of what gets signed so that the website can tell when an answer was made for somewhere else.
intrusion.reveal: The signed response had been made for a look-alike origin and relayed to the real site.

temptations.label: Skip the origin check when the signature is valid
temptations.why: A valid signature over the wrong origin is exactly what a relay produces. Valid is not the same as meant for you.

teaches: The browser, not the page, states the origin.
The authenticator has one key per site, so a look-alike has nothing to ask for.
The website checks the origin inside the signed data, not just the signature.
